personality_one_liner: High-contrast, utility-first digital bank with strict typography and striking lime-green accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards use md/lg margins. Elements inside the main card should be neatly spaced.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This is a brutalist, high-contrast design.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary dashboard focusing entirely on today's revenue and the main 'start workday' CTA.

states.loading: Spinner centered on the f4f4f4 surface.
states.empty: Should not be empty; default value is R$ 0,00.
states.error: Error message with a retry button to fetch earnings.

screens.layout: Header: 'Bom dia, Parceiro' (lg/xl font, onSurface) and today's date underneath (sm font, maybe muted/gray). Main Element: A single large credit-card style card (surfaceSecondary #010101, radius 32px, padding 24px) centered. Inside the card: Top subtitle 'Faturamento Hoje' in #c5f04a. Middle: 'R$ 0,00' huge text (4xl, white). Bottom: A wide, full-width button (brandSecondary #ffffff, text #010101) saying 'Iniciar Dia de Trabalho'. Optional: below the card, recent trips or mini stats.

screens.name: Goals (Metas)
screens.purpose: Track daily and weekly revenue goals with progress bars.

states.empty: Icon + 'No active goals' + button to 'Set a Goal'.

screens.layout: List of goals. Cards can be light with dark borders or dark cards. Use #c5f04a for progress bars.

screens.name: Balance (Balanço)
screens.layout: Top summary of total balance. Below: a list of recent transactions/trips. Brutalist list design: hard borders between items, clear typography for amounts.

screens.name: Profile (Perfil)
screens.layout: Avatar (or real image) at the top. List of settings items (Account, Vehicle, Support, Logout) using lucide icons. High contrast list rows.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Entry point for drivers to authenticate.

states.error: Toast or inline error for bad credentials.

screens.layout: Clean layout on #f4f4f4. Huge app title in Inter bold. Inputs with hard borders. Primary CTA 'Login' in #010101 with #ffffff text. Secondary button for 'Continue with Google'.

profile_avatar.alt: man driving a car wearing wrist watch

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: main background #f4f4f4, dark cards #010101, light text #ffffff, vibrant lime-green accent #c5f04a.
Use Inter font across the whole application.
The Bottom Navigation MUST have rounded top corners (e.g. borderTopLeftRadius 24, borderTopRightRadius 24) and a subtle shadow. The background of the nav bar is white or very light gray.

The Home screen main card MUST be #010101, border radius 32px, padding 24px (p-6 equivalent). It contains 'Faturamento Hoje' as subtitle, 'R$ 0,00' as big value, and a wide white button 'Iniciar Dia de Trabalho'.
Keep the UI layout 100% mobile and full screen.
Since it's a brutalist/digital bank style, rely on size and spacing for hierarchy instead of shadows and blur.
Use the image provided for the Profile avatar placeholder.
